pages.seals.client-side.label: Client-Side Engine
pages.seals.client-side.claim: Static QR generation runs entirely inside your browser sandbox.
pages.seals.client-side.p0.label: Local execution
pages.seals.client-side.p0.detail: Matrix computation, styling and rasterisation happen on your CPU in a Web Worker. No payload leaves the tab.
pages.seals.client-side.p1.label: Verify it yourself
pages.seals.client-side.p1.detail: Open the network panel while generating a static code — there is no outbound request carrying your data.
pages.seals.eea.label: EEA Hosting
pages.seals.eea.claim: Application servers, databases and backups stay inside the EEA.
pages.seals.eea.p0.label: Residency
pages.seals.eea.p0.detail: Managed PostgreSQL, backups and routing proxies operate strictly inside the European Economic Area.
pages.seals.eea.p1.label: No durable IP logs
pages.seals.eea.p1.detail: Transport metadata is processed in memory for routing and DDoS mitigation only.
pages.seals.gdpr.label: GDPR / AVG
pages.seals.gdpr.claim: Data minimisation by design under Belgian GBA/APD oversight.
pages.seals.gdpr.p0.label: Minimisation
pages.seals.gdpr.p0.detail: Only the fields required to resolve a dynamic link are stored, and only as long as the link lives.
pages.seals.gdpr.p1.label: Your rights
pages.seals.gdpr.p1.detail: Access, rectification, erasure and portability are handled from /privacy.
pages.seals.agpl.label: AGPL-3.0-or-later
pages.seals.agpl.claim: The full source is auditable and self-hostable.
pages.seals.agpl.p0.label: Network clause
pages.seals.agpl.p0.detail: Any hosted fork must publish its modifications, so the guarantees travel with the code.
pages.seals.agpl.p1.label: Self-hosting
pages.seals.agpl.p1.detail: A first-class path, documented in the self-hosting guide.
pages.seals.no-trackers.label: Zero Trackers
pages.seals.no-trackers.claim: No advertising cookies, fingerprinting or third-party analytics.
pages.seals.no-trackers.p0.label: No third-party scripts
pages.seals.no-trackers.p0.detail: The document loads no advertising or profiling script.
pages.seals.no-trackers.p1.label: Coarse analytics only
pages.seals.no-trackers.p1.detail: Scan stats are timestamp, country and device family — never identities.
